connector.name: Buggazi
connector.registryDescription: Project management for coding agents. Bugs, features, sprints. 73 tools, stdio or remote SSE.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.buggazi.com over server sent events, also runs locally from the npm package buggazi. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the jyswee account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token using your Buggazi API key: 'Bearer bgz_...'. Optional: without one the server starts in onboarding mode and can self-signup via the buggazi_signup tool.

env.name: BGZ_API_KEY
env.description: Buggazi API key (bgz_...). Optional: without a key the server starts in onboarding mode and can self-signup.
